subject: Recap: Redwood + Acme procurement path & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: J. Peters <j.peters@acme.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap: Redwood + Acme procurement path & next steps

Hi Jeff / Acme procurement team,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

- Discovery highlights:
  - Use case: embedding search and summarization for customer support KB (expected ~1M monthly requests).
  - Security: data residency ok in us-west, SOC 2 required (we provide attestation).
  - Success criteria: latency under 300ms p50 and predictable unit cost under $0.002/req.

- Procurement & commercial path questions we discussed:
  - Preferred payment method: PO vs corporate card? You mentioned procurement typically issues POs for platform vendors.
  - Finance preference: you noted smaller purchases go through AWS Marketplace; for platform agreements you often do direct vendor contracts.
  - Timeline: target pilot start late March; decision by mid-March would be ideal to meet that timeline.

Attachments I’m sending with this email: Redwood_Procurement_Checklist.pdf (quick checklist for finance), Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf (first draft SOW).

Next steps / ask:
1) Can you confirm whether Acme will route this via PO (vendor contract) or pursue Marketplace listing?
2) If PO, who is the PO issuer / finance contact and is net30 acceptable?
3) Would you like us to start the Marketplace inquiry in parallel (note it can add 4–6 weeks)?

I’ll loop Camila (solutions) to provide the vendor form and updated SOW if helpful. Happy to do weekly check-ins — is Wednesday AM a good cadence for you?

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

--
Attachments: Redwood_Procurement_Checklist.pdf, Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf

From: J. Peters <j.peters@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: Redwood + Acme procurement path & next steps

Thanks for the recap, Marissa — good summary. A few quick answers: 

- Procurement preference: we will likely route this as a PO to the vendor. Finance signs vendor contracts for platform-level purchases; Marketplace is typically used only for card/SMB purchases.
- Required docs: vendor form (company details + W9), executed SOW, insurance certs.
- Payment terms: Net30 is our standard for vendors.

I can start the vendor intake on our side once we have the filled vendor form and W9.

Weekly check-ins work for us — Wednesday mornings are fine.

Cheers,
Jeff Peters
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Corporation
j.peters@acme.com
+1 (212) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: J. Peters <j.peters@acme.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: Redwood + Acme procurement path & next steps

Thanks Jeff — helpful. Camila, copying you to share vendor form + W9 and to update SOW with the net30 term.

Camila — can you: 
- Attach a filled vendor form + our W9 (for Acme to intake).
- Add a short commercial summary to the SOW (pilot scope, pricing, pilot term) and prepare a DocuSign link so procurement can review.

A few notes for Acme: 
- Options for commercial path:
  1) Direct PO to Redwood (recommended for speed). We can sign vendor contract + SOW; expected procurement lead time depends on your intake queue (~1–3 weeks after we return forms).
  2) AWS Marketplace listing (requires our listing and additional validations) — this can be done but typically adds 4–6 weeks. Use this if your finance absolutely requires marketplace purchase flow.

If you confirm PO route and net30, I’ll mark us as ready to go on our side and Camila will share the updated SOW & vendor form today. Also attaching a HubSpot link for your reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

Would you like me to kick off the Marketplace inquiry in parallel or hold for now?

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, J. Peters <j.peters@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: Redwood + Acme procurement path & next steps

Marissa — attaching the vendor form (Acme_Vendor_Form_Filled.pdf) and our W9 (W9_Acme.pdf). I also updated Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf to include pilot scope and net30 payment term.

Notes for the team: 
- Pricing: kept pilot pricing as discussed — 3-week pilot capped at $5k, then scale pricing to be agreed for production.
- Marketplace: I recommend proceeding with PO route; marketplace will add friction unless procurement specifically needs it for internal chargeback.

Next actions: 
- Marissa: confirm PO contact at Acme (email for PO issuance) so we can issue invoice + PO instructions.
- Jeff / Acme: confirm if we should also open marketplace request in parallel.

Thanks — I’ll be on the weekly check-in if scheduled.

Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
